mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_chunk( report_id, chunk_index, chunk_uid, parent_chunk_uid, chunk_type, section_path, chunk_text, token_count, page_number, start_paragraph_id, end_paragraph_id, start_page_number, end_page_number, filter_reason, diagnostics, vector_stored, created_at ) VALUES( #{reportId}, #{chunkIndex}, #{chunkUid}, #{parentChunkUid}, #{chunkType}, #{sectionPath}, #{chunkText}, #{tokenCount}, #{pageNumber}, #{startParagraphId}, #{endParagraphId}, #{startPageNumber}, #{endPageNumber}, #{filterReason}, #{diagnostics}, #{vectorStored}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, chunk_index, chunk_uid, parent_chunk_uid, chunk_type, section_path, chunk_text, token_count, page_number, start_paragraph_id, end_paragraph_id, start_page_number, end_page_number, filter_reason, diagnostics, vector_stored, created_at FROM report_chunk WHERE chunk_uid = #{chunkUid}

SELECT id, report_id, chunk_index, chunk_uid, parent_chunk_uid, chunk_type, section_path, chunk_text, token_count, page_number, start_paragraph_id, end_paragraph_id, start_page_number, end_page_number, filter_reason, diagnostics, vector_stored, created_at FROM report_chunk WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY chunk_type DESC, chunk_index ASC

SELECT id, report_id, chunk_index, chunk_uid, parent_chunk_uid, chunk_type, section_path, chunk_text, token_count, page_number, start_paragraph_id, end_paragraph_id, start_page_number, end_page_number, filter_reason, diagnostics, vector_stored, created_at FROM report_chunk WHERE parent_chunk_uid = #{parentChunkUid} AND chunk_type = 'CHILD' ORDER BY chunk_index ASC
